selectionReason: Nov 12 Nvidia CEO transition and Nebius capacity delays, against 7/30/90-day AI valuation and financing pressures, match underused HL008 and HL012. These are learning analogies, not price predictions; neither repeats Nov 12 HL002/HL014.

cards.title: Long booms can conceal weak foundations
cards.question: What financing assumptions could break?
cards.prompt: Apply original handwritten lesson HL008 to Nov 10 CoreWeave backlog and Nov 12 Nebius capacity delays. Compare 2027 committed capex, contracted vs live MW, interest burden, utilization and free cash flow; distinguish a durable boom from fragile funding. Do not predict a crash from analogy. https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx https://www.reuters.com/technology/nebius-beats-quarterly-revenue-estimates-strong-ai-demand-2026-11-12/

cards.title: Use multiple independent research channels
cards.question: Does the evidence survive source checks?
cards.prompt: Apply handwritten lesson HL012 to Nvidia Nov 12 leadership transition and Nov 17 earnings. Cross-check official corporate release, earnings, Reuters and competitors; distinguish verified succession from speculation about future market share.
